description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git and Perforce integration, particularly focusing on Git LFS features. It defines functions for testing files in LFS, sets up repositories, and runs multiple tests to verify the correct handling of large files, file extensions, and configurations related to Git LFS.

methods.name: test_file_in_lfs
methods.description: Verifies a file is correctly stored in Git LFS by checking its metadata and content against expected values.

methods.name: test_file_count_in_dir
methods.description: Checks the number of files in a given directory, typically to verify the number of objects stored in Git LFS.
